summary: Iteration 8: Verified vendor-portal shipment 404 fix. Backend pytest (8/8 pass) covers records list, pending POs list, admin-forbidden, item_index/qty validation, non-owned PO 404, empty items 400, and shipping_cost fallback to pricelist sum. Frontend Playwright confirms /vendor/shipments loads clean (no red 404 AxiosError overlay), both 'PO yang perlu dikirim' and 'Riwayat Pengiriman' tables render, SHP-20260818-F4F13 present, 'Buat Pengiriman' dialog opens with all vsh-* testids, submit creates shipment (records grew 2→3, new SHP-20260818-5D7E3 visible).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_vendor_portal.py L668: shipping_cost fallback uses `float(payload.shipping_cost or 0) or pl_total` — works but be aware that an explicit 0 with a non-empty pricelist will always be overridden by pl_total (documented behavior per task, but could surprise if a vendor genuinely wants free shipping with a pricelist for record only).

VendorShipments dialog: qty inputs are disabled unless the item checkbox is toggled — good UX, but there is no visible validation message when user submits with 0 active items (backend responds 400 which surfaces as axios toast — acceptable).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test shipments during testing: one via pytest (SHP with shipping_cost=25000 via pricelist fallback) and one via Playwright UI (SHP-20260818-5D7E3 with JNE-UI carrier/UI-ITER8-FINAL tracking). Both persist against PO-20260818-7CDE6.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vendor portal /vendor/shipments is now stable. Records for test vendor now include multiple SHP-* entries; next testers should not rely on record count == 1. All vsh-* data-testids present and working. Backend endpoints: GET/POST /api/vendor-portal/shipments, GET /api/vendor-portal/shipments/records — all 200 for vendor role, forbidden for admin.
rca of the issue: Prior 404 was caused by missing FastAPI route handlers for GET /vendor-portal/shipments/records and POST /vendor-portal/shipments — a silent search_replace failure meant the intended insertion never landed in routes_vendor_portal.py. Fix (already applied by main agent) re-inserted both handlers adjacent to the existing GET /vendor-portal/shipments. Regression coverage added via /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8_shipment.py so a future silent no-op edit will be detected by the 200-status assertions.
